Players Committee card image of [[Darth Maul, Lone Hunter (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “If drawn for destiny, may take into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. Cancels Blaster Deflection (and Amidala's game text) here. Maul's weapon destiny draws may not be modified or canceled by opponent. Immune to attrition < 5.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Dark/large/darthmaullonehunter.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 a5142dd] (12 May 2020). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
